title: Slider with floats do not use the step parameter based on min_value when step can be casted to int (e.g. 1.0)

comments.body:
**If this issue affects you, please react with a 👍 (thumbs up emoji) to the initial post.**

Your feedback helps us prioritize which bugs to investigate and address first.

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-9184)

[USER] Thanks for raising this issue. I was able to reproduce it [here](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-9184). This will need a bit more internal discussion. Since this is our behavior for sliders forever, we might not want to change it.
[USER] thanks for the feedback. I think it is quite an important bug, as users expect the same behaviour for the step parameter regardless if it is castable to int or not.

Oh, got it. There is some inconsistency in how values are handled. E.g., when using step `1.0` vs `1.1`. I extended the example a bit [here](https://issues.streamlit.app/?issue=gh-9184). That is indeed something we should try to fix. It looks like it needs to be addressed inside baseweb.
Closing this since it was fixed with the recent migration from baseweb to react-aria
